title: The Unsolvable Ice Trap
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Haibara, Agasa, the Detective Boys, and the local Niigata Prefectural Police inspector who runs the formal interrogation) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: the murder mechanism is a delayed, killer-absent remote-trigger rig (ice-embedded weighted glass block + string garrote freed by a burning magnesium ribbon once the ice refreezes around it), represented as direct typed edges. Old cases/ep687 file got the culprit ID right (Shiota) but reduced the whole plot to three generic `knows` edges and a single-object motive field marked 'unspecified' -- the transcript is explicit: Shiota overheard mayor Yamaguchi and secretary Ogi discussing that they had cut the brakes on former mayor Itakura's car (Mika's father) to cover up their embezzlement of festival funds after Itakura discovered it, and killed Yamaguchi in revenge while also collapsing the festival's main gate the night before to manufacture an ironclad overnight group alibi for Mika (Itakura's daughter, whom he was protecting). None of that backstory murder, conspiracy, or alibi-engineering existed in the old file. case_type: murder.

clues.desc: Magnesium oxide on Shiota's sleeve matches the same compound found inside the VIP dome -- ties the man who burned the trigger free to the residue left by the burn itself.
The VIP bed is oddly small for such a spacious dome, sized to the mayor's exact height and sleep position -- only the hotel's designer could have known that placement well enough to aim the rig.
